definitions.faces: planar face walk inside each district ring over the ring outline and the MeasureInput way edges inside it (midpoint inside, ends inside or on the outline); outline split at way nodes on it; face area = cycle area less the outer cycles of way components that do not touch the outline
definitions.bands: half widths (m) {"arterial": 2.5, "lane": 1.25, "street": 1.25, "track": 0.625}, wall 3.0; round-joined (distance to the centreline)
definitions.scanline: row spacing 50 cm, exact x lengths per row
definitions.stem: T stem: degree 3, the two other arms turn < 20 degrees
